title: LLM usage inventoried
guidance: Every model call site should be known and listed. Cybwaycard derives this from imports, API hosts and call names; keep model access behind one module so the inventory stays short.

title: No hardcoded credentials
guidance: Move keys to environment variables or a secret store; rotate any key that was committed. Values shown here are redacted at scan time.

title: Credentials sourced from environment
guidance: Keep it this way: no key literal in code, CI, or docs.

guidance: Add a budget object that is charged BEFORE each network call and raises when the ceiling would be exceeded. A dashboard alert is not a control; code is.

title: Independent verification of model output
evidence: src/cybwaydb/agents.py:1 — """AI layer: auditor agent + independent checker agent.
src/cybwaydb/agents.py:4 — - The checker NEVER grades its own generation: it re-derives ground truth
src/cybwaydb/agents.py:7 — - Every finding is adjudicated PASS / REVIEW / QUARANTINE.
src/cybwaydb/agents.py:33 — ground_truth = [f.to_dict() for f in run_all_rules(conn) if f.status == FAIL]
guidance: Re-derive the claim from source data (a rule engine, a second independent check) and adjudicate PASS / REVIEW / QUARANTINE. The model must never grade its own output.

title: Structured output validated

guidance: Ask for strict JSON, parse it inside try/except, and validate the shape (schema, allowed values) before anything downstream reads it.

title: Tamper-evident audit log
evidence: src/cybwaydb/auditlog.py:5 — breaks the chain and is detected by verify_chain().
src/cybwaydb/auditlog.py:59 — return False, f"chain broken at entry {i}: expected prev_hash {prev}"
guidance: Hash-chain the log (each entry carries the SHA-256 of the previous) and write a manifest of run outputs so edits, deletions and reordering are detectable.

title: Drift / regression detection
evidence: src/cybwaydb/cli.py:51 — p_drift = sub.add_parser("drift", help="Diff security posture between two scans")
src/cybwaydb/cli.py:52 — p_drift.add_argument("--old", required=True, help="Previous run's findings.json")

src/cybwaydb/cli.py:122 — return 0 if d["verdict"] != "REGRESSED" else 1  # CI-friendly: regression fails the pipeline
guidance: Diff each run against the previous one and fail CI when a previously passing case regresses. Model updates change behaviour silently.

title: Model identifier declared
guidance: Name the exact model in code (env-overridable), so a card and a benchmark can say which model produced which numbers.

title: Explicit timeouts on model calls
evidence: src/cybwaydb/providers.py:92 — with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
guidance: Pass an explicit timeout and a bounded retry count to the client; SDK defaults are generous and invisible in a review.

title: Tests and CI present
guidance: Governance claims need a test that fails when the control is removed, and a CI job that runs it on every push.

title: CI runs without model API secrets
guidance: Run CI in mock mode. If a live job is needed, isolate it behind a manual trigger with its own budget ceiling.

title: License and intended-use documentation
guidance: State the license and, in the README's first paragraph, what the system is for and what it must not be used for. The card quotes that paragraph as the intended use.

title: Dependencies pinned
guidance: Pin every runtime dependency to an exact version (==) and bump deliberately; model SDKs change behaviour between minor versions.
